picks.thesis: Convergence: at least four House members — Cisneros, Allen, Letlow and Fields — disclosed TSM buys (each $1k-15k bands, tx dates Jan-May, several lags of 20-39 days so partly stale). Decisively, on 2026-06-05 eleven TSM executives including Chairman/CEO Wei Che-Chia and EVP Co-COO Mii bought stock open-market, non-10b5-1, filed within four days. Broad, fresh C-suite buying is the strong leg; the congressional buys are older and small. TSM last 424.61, down 8.1% over 30 days, mid its 90-day 367.22-477.57 range.

All amount bands are small ($1k-15k); disclosed sizes are ranges, not exact.
Eleven same-week insider buys may reflect a routine program rather than opportunistic accumulation.
picks.invalidation: TSM insiders begin filing sales, or no further insider buying follows the 2026-06-05 cluster while the stale congressional leg is the only remaining support.
